text:
maria: FYI customer reported 401 when using node-sdk with API_KEY set from a systemd unit. It works locally. Anyone seen systemd/env weirdness?
leo: Yep. systemd Environment= can include quotes or escapes depending on how the unit file was edited. Also trailing newlines sometimes sneak in when copying from editors.
sam: Can you paste the ExecStart / Environment line and a snip of the header the customer sees?
maria: ExecStart=/usr/bin/node /srv/app/index.js
Environment=API_KEY=\"sk_live_ABC123\"
They pasted this header from their app logs: `Authorization: Basic c2tfbGl2X0FCQzEyMzo=` which decodes to `sk_live_ABC123:` (looks like a colon appended)
carla: A trailing newline in the env value -> base64 ends with a linefeed encoded as part of the token sometimes. In basic auth it becomes `token:` or `token\n` depending on client.
leo: Quick checks: in node run `console.log(JSON.stringify(process.env.API_KEY))` to see literal value (will show "sk_live_ABC123\n" if newline). In ruby `puts ENV['API_KEY'].inspect` does similar.
sam: Also check if the systemd unit used `EnvironmentFile=` and the file has `API_KEY=sk_live_ABC123\n` (common). systemd will include the newline as part of the value if the file has trailing CR/LF and isn't sanitized.
maria: repro from their container: `echo -n $API_KEY | base64` gave `c2tfbGl2X0FCQzEyMzoxCg==` vs `echo $API_KEY | base64` gave slightly different string. They were doing `echo $API_KEY` in logs which added newline.
carla: For immediate fix you can trim in-app: `const key = process.env.API_KEY && process.env.API_KEY.trim()` or in systemd use `EnvironmentFile=/etc/myapp/credentials` and ensure the file has no trailing newline or use `sed -i -e '$a\'`? (actually that adds). Better: `printf 'API_KEY=sk_live_ABC123' > /etc/myapp/credentials` to avoid trailing LF.
leo: Another option is to instruct the SDK/header builder to not append `:` when using token auth — but trimming the env is simplest.
sam: If you want to detect silently: add a startup check in health probe: `if (process.env.API_KEY && /\s/.test(process.env.API_KEY)) console.warn('API_KEY contains whitespace')`
maria: thanks — shared those quick checks with customer. They trimmed env file and switched to `echo -n` when testing and the 401 went away. :tada:
deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-17T14:20:00Z succeeded for service/my-app (no config changes)
carla: small note for docs: add a short blurb in devex FAQ about systemd/EnvironmentFile newline gotchas + `JSON.stringify(process.env...)` debug tip.
maria: good call — I'll open a tiny PR to add a one-liner.
leo: ack, can review.
